notes.title: INTERGALACTIC ECSTASY, a new Erotic Adventure/RPG arrives in one week!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33733604/a5388198edd2d82d3500cdbeaf22e39938ca4f9d.png[/img]

In one week, join Penny Patty Piper on her Epic sexual adventure across the universe, fighting alien monsters and having lots of steamy, fun sex along the way.

Fight your way through a number of alien worlds in Third-Person-Shooter action, and guide Penny as she completes a number of intense sexual challenges to earn the fabled Erotesian stones, the keys to a civilization where fun, casual sex is a way of life.

This new Erotic Adventure by HFTGames features:
[list]
[*]A Super-Sexy Erotic Story[*]Numerous Interactive Sex Scenes[*]Professional Voice-Over[*]Full Realtime 3D Gameplay[*]STEAM Achievements
[/list]
Add INTERGALACTIC ECSTASY to your Wishlist now, and get it on Friday January 26th!
